description: This file defines the SubjectsNotAccessibleException class, a specific exception used in the context of policy subject access issues within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides mechanisms for creation, JSON parsing, and header management related to the exception.

classes.name: SubjectsNotAccessibleException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that subjects could not be accessed due to missing authorization, embedding error code, HTTP status code, headers, and additional context.

classes.name: SubjectsNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate construction of SubjectsNotAccessibleException instances with optional detailed attributes.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for SubjectsNotAccessibleException with specified policy ID and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a simple message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
